# Version 3.0.0
> **First SkiaSharp v3 release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the binding surface and platform packages on top of an updated Skia engine. This major release adds span-based APIs, modern graphics views, and updated platform support. Review the API diff before upgrading from v2.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy v2 APIs removed** — The v3 surface removes obsolete and incompatible APIs from earlier releases. Review the API diff and update code to the replacement APIs before upgrading.

## Engine

- **Skia engine updated** — Refreshes the bundled Skia renderer and its native dependencies for the v3 release.

## API Surface

- **Modern drawing and span-based APIs added** — Adds Span overloads, new picture and color-filter APIs, SKBlender, and expanded image and animation support.

## Platform

- **Views and graphics backends expanded** — Adds and updates accelerated view support across Blazor, WinUI, WPF, Mac Catalyst, and other platform packages.

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp binding and native text-shaping dependency for the v3 release.
